desc.en: This dua may also be recited after performing the ziyarat of Imam Reza (a) and other infallible Imams (a)…
desc.rurdu: Imam Reza (a) aur digar Masoomeen (a) ki ziyarat ke baad is dua ko bhi padhe…
desc.urdu: امام علی رضاؑ اور دگر معسومینؑ کی زیارت کے بعد اس دُعا کو بھی پڑھے۔۔۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَوْ وَجَدْتُ شَفِيْعًا اَقْرَبَ اِلَيْكَ مِنْ مُّحَمَّدٍ وَّاَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الْاَخْيَارِ الْاَتْقِيَآءِ الْاَبْرَارِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ لَا سْتَشْفَعْتُ بِهِمْ اِلَيْكَ وَهٰذَا قَبْرُ وَلِيٍّ مِّنْ اَوْلِيَآئِكَ‏ وَسَيِّدٍ مِّنْ اَصْفِيَآئِكَ وَمَنْ فَرَضْتَ عَلَى الْخَلْقِ طَاعَتَهٗ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA LAW WA JADTO SHAFEE-A’N AQRABA ILAIKA MIM MOHAMMADIW WA AHLE-BAIYTE-HIL AKHYAA-RIL ATQEYAAA-IL ABRAA-RE A’LAI-HE WA A’LAI-HE-MUS SALAAMO LAS TASHFA’TO BE-HIM ILAIKA WA HAAZAA QABRO WALIY-YIM MIN AWLIYAAA-E-KA WA SAYYE-DIM MIN ASFEYAAA-E-KA WA MAN FARAZ-TA A’LAL KHALQE TAA-A’TA-HU.

trans.en: O Allah! Had I known interceders that are closer to You than Muhammad and his household the virtuous, the devout and the pious, blessing be upon him and them, I would have taken them as interceders to You. And this is the grave of one of Your successors, and leader from Your chosen ones. And You have made obligatory upon the creature for his obedience.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: قَدْ جَعَلْتُهٗ بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ اَسْاَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ بِحُرْمَتِهٖ عِنْدَكَ وَبِحَقِّهٖ عَلَيْكَ لَمَّا نَظَرْتَ اِلَيَّ نَظْرَةً رَحِيْمَةً مِّنْ نَظَرَاتِكَ تَلُمُّ بِهَا شَعَثِيْ وَتَصْلُحُ بِهَا حَالِيْ فِيْ الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ فَاِنَّكَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيْرٌ۔

lines.rarabic: QAD JA-A’LTA-HU BAIYNA YADAIY-YA AS-ALOKA YAA RABBE BE-HUR-MATE-HI I’NDAKA WA BE-HAQQE-HI A’LAIKA LAMMAA NAZAR-TA ILAIYYA NAZRA-TAN RAHEEMA-TAM MIN NAZA-RAATE-KA TA-LUMMO BEHAA SHA-A’SEE WA TASLO-HO BEHAA HAALEE FID-DUNYAA WAL AAKHERA-TE FA-INNAKA A’LAA KULLE SHAI-IN QADEE-ROON.

trans.en: Certainly, You have put them in front of us. I ask You, O my Lord! By his right near You, and his sanctity near You, and by his right upon You, to take a merciful look at me from Your merciful looks, reunite my scattering, and reform my condition by it in this world and the hereafter, then surely You have power over all things.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ ذُنُوْبِيْ لَمَّا فَاتَتِ الْعَدَدَ وَجَازَتِ الْاَمَدَ عَلِمْتُ اَنَّ شَفَاعَةَ كُلِّ شَافِعٍ دُوْنَ اَوْلِيَآئِكَ تَقْصُرُ عَنْهَا فَوَصَلْتُ الْمَسِيْرَ مِنْ بَلَدَيِ قَاصِدًا وَلِيَّكَ بِالْبُشْرٰى وَمُتَعَلِّقًا مِنْهُ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقٰى وَهَا اَنَا يَا مَوْلَايَ قَدِ اسْتَشْفَعْتُ بِهٖ اِلَيْكَ وَاَقْسَمْتُ بِهٖ عَلَيْكَ فَارْحَمْ غُرْبَتِيْ وَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِيْ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA INNA ZONOO-BEE LAMMAA FAATA-TIL A’DADA WA JAAZA-TIL AMADA A’LIMTO ANNA SHAFAA-A’TA KULLE SHAAFE-I’N DOONA AWLIYAAA-E-KA TAQSORO A’NHAA FAWA-SAL-TUL MASEERA MIN BALADE-YA QAASE-DAN WALYYA-KA BIL-BUSHRA WA MOTA-A’LLE-QAN MINHO BIL-OO’R-WA-TIL WUSQAA WA HAA ANAA YAA MAWLAAYA QA-DIS TASH-FA’TO BEHEE ILAIKA WA AQ-SAMTO BEHI A’LAIKA FAR-HAM GHURBATI WAQ-BAL TAWBA-TEE.

trans.en: O Allah! Surely the time of counting my sins has expired and size has exceeded, I know that intercession of all the intercessors other than Your guardians will fell short for it, then I journeyed from my city straight to Your guardian with good news and held fast to him with strong rope, here I am, O my master! Certainly, seeking your intercession with it from you, and I swear with it to you, then have mercy on my poverty and accept my repentance.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيْ لَا اُعَوِّلُ عَلٰى صَالِحَةٍ سَلَفَتْ مِنِّيْ وَلَا اَثِقُ بِحَسَنَةٍ تَقُوْمُ بِالْحُجَّةِ عَنِّيْ وَلَوْ اَنِّيْ قَدَّمْتُ حَسَنَاتِ جَمِيْعِ خَلْقِكَ ثُمَّ خَالَفْتُ طَاعَةَ اَوْلِيَآئِكَ لَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ الْـحَسَنَاتُ مُزْعِـجَةً لِّيْ عَنْ جِوَارِكَ غَيْرَ حَآئِلَةٍۢ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ نَارِكَ فَلِذٰلِكَ عَلِمْتُ اَنَّ اَفْضَلَ طَاعَتِكَ طَاعَةُ اَوْلِيَآئِكَ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA INNEE LAA O-A’WWELO A’LAA SAALE-HATIN SALA-FAT MINNEE WA LAA A-SEKO BE-HASANA-TIN TAQOO-MO BIL-HUJJATE ANNEE WA LAW ANNEE QADDAM-TO HASANAA-TE JAMEE-E’ KHALQE-KA SUMMA KHAALAF-TO TAA-A’TA AWLEYAAA-E-KA LA-KAA-NAT TILKAL HASANAATO MAZ-E’JATAL LEE A’N JAWAARE-KA GHAIRA HAA-E-LA-TAM BAIYNEE WA BAIYNA NAARE-KA FALE-ZAALE-KA A’LIMTO ANNA AFZALA TAA-A’TEKA TAA-A’TO AWLIYAAA-E-KA.

trans.en: O Allah! Surely, I do not rely on my past virtuous actions, and I do not rely upon good actions performed with evidence from me, but if I come with all the good deeds of Your creatures then disobey the order of Your guardian, these good deeds will keep me away from Your vicinity, not coming as a barrier between me and Your fire. Then for this I know that the best obedience is the obedience of Your guardian.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْحَمْ تَوَجُّهِيْ بِمَنْ تَوَجَّهْتُ بِهٖ اِلَيْكَ فَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ اَنِّيْ غَيْرُ وَاجِدٍ اَعْظَمُ مِقْدَارًا مِّنْهُمْ لِمَكَانِهِمْ مِنْكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّكَ بِالْاِنْعَامِ مَوْصُوْفٌ وَ وَلِيُّكَ بِالشَّفَاعَةِ لِمَنْ اَتَاهُ مَعْرُوْفٌ فَاِذَا شَفَعَ فِيَّ مُتَفَضِّلًا كَانَ وَجْهُكَ عَلَيَّ مُقْبِلًا وَاِذَا كَانَ وَجْهُكَ عَلَيَّ مُقْبِلًا اَصَبْتُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْزِلًا۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUM-MAR HAM TAWAJJO-HEE BE-MAN TAWAJJAH-TO BEHEE ILAIKA FALA-QAD A’LIMTA ANNEE GHAIRO WAAJE-DIN A’ZAMO MIQDAA-RAM MIN-HUM LE-MAKAANE-HIM MINKA YAA AR-HAMAR RAAHE-MEEN. ALLAAHUMMA INNAKA BIL-IN-AA’ME MAWSOO-FOON WA WALIYYO-KA BISH-SHAFAA-A’TE LE-MAN ATAA-HO MA’ROO-FOON FA-IZAA SHAFA-A’ FEEYA MOTA-FAZZE-LAN KAANA WAJHO-KA A’LAIYYA MUQBE-LAN WA IZAA KAANA WAJHO-KA A’LAIYYA MUQBE-LAN A-SAB-TO MINAL JANNATE MANZE-LAN.

trans.en: O Allah! Have mercy on my approach by what I have turned to You, then surely You know that I cannot find anybody greater than You, for the place he has in front of You, O Most Merciful of all! O Allah! Surely You are described with the bestowing and Your vicegerent with intercession towards the one who is known, then intercede for me with grace, as Your face (of mercy) is approaching me, and if Your face is approaching me than Paradise will be my residence.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَكَمَا اَتَوَسَّلُ بِهٖ اِلَيْكَ اَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيَّ بِالرِّضَا وَالنِّعَمِ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ اَرْضِهٖ عَنَّا وَلَا تُسْخِطْهُ عَلَيْنَا وَاهْدِنَا بِهٖ وَلَا تُضِلَّنَا فِيْهِ وَاجْعَلْنَا فِيْهِ عَلَى السَّبِيْلِ الَّذِيْ تَخْتَارُهٗ وَاَضِفْ طَاعَتِيْ اِلٰى خَالِصِ نِيَّتِيْ فِيْ تَحِيَّتِيْ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA FA-KAMAA ATA-WASSALO BEHEE ILAIKA AN TAMUNNA A’LAIYYA BIR-REZAA WAN-NE-A’AME. ALLAAHUMMA ARZE-HI ANNAA WA LAA TUS-KHIT-HO A’LAI-NAA WAHDE-NAA BEHEE WA LAA TOZIL-LANAA FEEHE WAJ-A’LNAA FEEHE A’LASSA-BEE-LIL LAZEE TAKH-TAARO-HU WA AZIF TAA-A’TEE ILAA KHAALE-SE NIYYATEE FEE TA-HIYYA-TEE YAA AR-HAMAR RAAHE-MEENA.

trans.en: O Allah! Then I seek intercession with You that bestow upon me with pleasure and bounty. O Allah! Make him happy from us, and do not enrage on us, and guide us to him and do not deviate in it, and make for us in it a way which he has chosen, and increase my obedience till (it reach) pure intention in my greetings, O Most Merciful of all!

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى خِيَارِ خَلْقِكَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِهٖ كَمَا انْتَجَبْتَهُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِيْنَ وَاخْتَرْتَهُمْ عَلٰى عِلْمٍ مِنَ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى حُجَّتِكَ وَصَفْوَتِكَ مِنْ بَرِيَّتِكَ اَلتَّالِيْ لِنَبِيِّكَ الْمُقِيْمِ لِاَمْرِكَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَبِيْ طَالِبٍ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَآءِ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَآءِ الْعَالَمِيْنَ وَصَلِّ عَلَى الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ شَنَفَيْ عَرْشِكَ وَدَلِيْلَيْ خَلْقِكَ ‏عَلَيْكَ وَدُعَاتِهِمْ اِلَيْكَ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA KHEYAARE KHALQE-KA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE-HI KAMAN TA-JABTA-HUM A’LAL A’ALAMEENA WAKH-TARTA-HUM A’LAA I’L-MIN MINAL AWWALEENA. ALLAAHUMMA WA-SALLE A’LAA HUJJATE-KA WA SAFWATE-KA MIN BARIY-YATE-KA ATTAA-LEE LE-NABIYYE-KAL MOQEE-ME LE-AMRE-KA A’LIYYIB-NE ABEE TAALE-BIN WA SALLE A’LAA FAATEMA-TAZ ZAHRAAA-E SAYYADA-TE NESAAA-IL A’A-LAMEENA WA SALLE A’LAL HASANE WAL HUSAINE SHANA-FAIY A’R-SHE-KA WA DALEE-LEE KHALQE-KA A’LAIKA WA DO-A’ATE-HIM ILAIKA.

trans.en: O Allah! Send blessings upon the best of Your creature, Muhammad and his progeny, like You have selected them upon the worlds, and chosen them from the past (generation). O Allah! And send blessings upon Your vicegerent, and Your chosen one from Your creatures, subsequently on Your Prophet, endurer for Your command, Ali Ibn Abi Taalib and send blessings upon Fatema Zahra, the mistress of the women of the worlds, and send blessings upon al-Hasan and al-Husain, the two earings of Your throne, and Your two proofs for Your creatures upon You, and callers towards You.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلٰى عَلِيٍّ وَمُحَمَّدٍ وَ جَعْفَرٍ وَمُوْسٰى وَعَلِيٍّ وَمُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلِيٍّ وَالْحَسَنِ وَالْخَلَفِ الصَّالِحِ الْبَاقِيْ مَصَابِيْحِ الظَّلَامِ وَحُجَجِكَ عَلٰى جَمِيْعِ الْاَنَامِ خَزَنَةِ الْعِلْمِ اَنْ يَعْدِمَ وَحُمَاةِ الدِّيْنِ اَنْ يَّسْقُمَ صَلَاةً يَكُوْنُ الْجَزَآءُ عَلَيْهَا اَتَمَّ رِضْوَانِكَ وَنَوَامِيَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَكَرَآئِمَ اِحْسَانِكَ۔ اَللّٰهُمَّ الْعَنْ اَعْدَآئَهُمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ وَضَاعِفْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعَذَابَ الْاَلِيْمَ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهٗ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAAHUMMA SALLE A’LAA A’LIYYIN WA MOHAMMADIN WA JA’FARIN WA MOOSA WA A’LIYYIN WA MOHAMMADIN WA A’LIYYIN WAL HASANE WAL KHALA-FIS SAALE-HIL BAAQEE MASAA-BEE-HIZ ZALAAME WA HOJAJE-KA A’LAA JAMEE-I’L ANAAME KHAZA-NATIL I’LME AN YA’DEMA WA HOMAA-TID DEENE AN YASQO-MA SALAA-TAN YAKOO-NUL JAZAAA-O A’LAI-HAA ATAMMA RIZWAANE-KA WA NAWAAME-YA BARA-KAATE-KA WA KARAAA-E-ME EHSAANE-KA. ALLAAHUM-MAL A’N A’DAAA-A-HUM MINAL JINNE WAL INSE AJMA-EE’NA WA ZAA-I’F A’LAIHE-MUL A’ZAA-BAL ALEEMA WAS-SALAAMO ALAIKA WA RAHMA-TULLAA-HE WA BARA-KAATO-HU.

trans.en: O Allah! And send blessings upon Ali, Muhammad, Ja’far, Moosa, Ali, Muhammad, Ali, al-Hasan and the remaining pious successors lamps of the darkness, and guides for the whole mankind, mines of the knowledge for the deprived, and patrons of the religion for the sick a blessing whose reward is complete and Your happiness, and Your perfect benedictions, and Your noble favouring. O Allah! Send curse upon their enemies from all the Jinn and the men, and increase their painful chastisement and Peace be on you and mercy of Allah and his blessing.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
